documents.title: Spec — weekly meal plan sharing
documents.content:
Spec — weekly meal plan sharing

## Goal
An owner shares a week's plan with one other household member by email.

## Requirements
1. Invite by email address.
2. An invalid address gives a clear error and no invite.
3. Both can edit any meal; the last change is shown with who made it.

## Non-goals
- chat; sharing beyond one household

3. Second household refused — Ana invites a third person — refused (Non-goal) — data: plan-1, ana, ben
